name: John Williams
caption: A play-by-play announcer who joined the promotion from the ICW after its founder stepped back, and called its return broadcasts in 2001.

tenures.source: the promotion's own reopening handbook (17 January 2001) and its own posted account of a grudge match (29 January 2001)
tenures.note: The handbook's own staff bio says he joined "when Sebastian Myerson had his little breakdown," placing his arrival within the promotion's earlier run, before its own September 2000 closure.

tenures.source: The fed's own 2002 documents: its own FAQ of 27 February 2002 and its broadcasts from Friday Night Fallout, 15 March 2002 to Friday Night Fallout, 3 June 2002.

name: Devon Case
caption: A Las Vegas wrestler billed "the Devious One," who fought a guest opponent to a draw in a lengthy grudge match.

tenures.source: the promotion's own posted account of a grudge match against a guest opponent, 29 January 2001
tenures.note: Billed from Las Vegas, Nevada, at 225 pounds; a follow-up note to the same post says he was not confirmed for the promotion's 2001 return.

name: James Morgan
notes: Debuted in the LVPWA on Heavy Metal Monday of 16 May 2000 and met Mad Goat there on 3 June 2000; his LVPWA roleplays run to November 2000. N.E.W. introduced him on On the Spot of 29 October 2000, and he met Edmond Winston IV at Slam Dance II. In a flash of 18 December 2000 he tears down a Hell for the Holidays IV poster and tells Marco Carlson that he will take his friend from him.
caption: A National Extreme Wrestling outsider known from one flash of 18 December 2000.
